lessons.key: ac_gap::denylist scan tests must be discrimination tested in the same task the t4 literal guard initially scanned wrong relative paths and passed vacuously inject a violation and confirm the scan finds it before committing any file walking assertion
lessons.text: Denylist/scan tests must be discrimination-tested in the same task: the T4 literal guard initially scanned wrong relative paths and passed vacuously; inject a violation and confirm the scan finds it before committing any file-walking assertion.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::when an implementation value drifts from a recorded ad decision 5s 8s test shift update the ad record in the same commit that changes the value so the decision log never disagrees with the code
lessons.text: When an implementation value drifts from a recorded AD decision (5s -> 8s test shift), update the AD record in the same commit that changes the value so the decision log never disagrees with the code.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::when a spec ac requires displaying the server s rejection reason assert a value matcher on the reason text e g room not found not merely that some error text is visible
lessons.text: When a spec AC requires displaying the server's rejection reason, assert a value matcher on the reason text (e.g. /room not found/), not merely that some error text is visible.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::an ac listing multiple rejection causes needs one test path per cause need more players and round already active are separate scenarios not one
lessons.text: An AC listing multiple rejection causes needs one test path per cause - 'need more players' and 'round already active' are separate scenarios, not one.

lessons.key: gate_fail::the vite dev proxy must forward the colyseus room websocket path processid roomid sdk client buildendpoint not a fixed websocket the same origin gate 3 harness cannot catch dev proxy breakage verify pnpm boot manually when touching vite config or the connection layer
lessons.text: The vite dev proxy must forward the colyseus room websocket path /<processId>/<roomId> (SDK Client.buildEndpoint), not a fixed /websocket — the same-origin gate-3 harness cannot catch dev-proxy breakage; verify pnpm boot manually when touching vite.config or the connection layer.

lessons.text: Assert the exact field values of every event emitted in a multi-event tick, not just the event count

lessons.text: Test the newly-allowed behavior after a phase transition, not only the confinement directions

lessons.key: spec_deviation::narrowing a broadcast policy mid game requires a matching departure event player left floor or stale rectangles persist on departed floors routing changes must be client coherence audited
lessons.text: Narrowing a broadcast policy mid-game requires a matching departure event (player:left-floor) or stale rectangles persist on departed floors — routing changes must be client-coherence audited.

lessons.key: ac_gap::in server tests intent ws arrival races fixed driveticks counts await events with a drive until event loop and never assume a fixed tick offset lands inside a segment
lessons.text: In server tests, intent WS arrival races fixed __driveTicks counts — await events with a drive-until-event loop and never assume a fixed tick offset lands inside a segment.

lessons.key: ac_gap::when a sim behavior has a room side trigger join leave lock the sim test proves the sim half only the fix feature task must name a room level integration test for the trigger itself or the wiring ships untested
lessons.text: When a sim behavior has a room-side trigger (join/leave/lock), the sim test proves the sim half only — the fix/feature task must name a room-level integration test for the trigger itself or the wiring ships untested.

lessons.key: ac_gap::before rewriting a large test suite list its existing pinned behaviors test titles ids and diff that list after the rewrite wholesale rewrites silently drop pins that only the sensor or verifier catches later
lessons.text: Before rewriting a large test suite, list its existing pinned behaviors (test titles/ids) and diff that list after the rewrite — wholesale rewrites silently drop pins that only the sensor or verifier catches later.

lessons.text: Kill stale dev servers on :2567/:5173 before running pnpm test:client — the Playwright webServer refuses to boot otherwise and the gate fails at startup, not in any test.
evidence: apps/client/harness/playwright.config.ts webServer (:2567/:5173), recurred in both verifier rounds (apps/client,harness,gate-3)

lessons.key: ac_gap::when a spec anchors visual timing to a public event tests must measure from that event receipt rather than from a later local animation phase
lessons.text: When a spec anchors visual timing to a public event, tests must measure from that event receipt rather than from a later local animation phase.

lessons.key: ac_gap::if an animation spec says timings come from shared tuning and event timestamps the presenter api must carry those anchors and tests must prove those constants are actually used
lessons.text: If an animation spec says timings come from shared TUNING and event timestamps, the presenter API must carry those anchors and tests must prove those constants are actually used.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::animation tests must observe rendered geometry or an equivalent stable visual signal visibility only assertions do not protect open vs closed states
lessons.text: Animation tests must observe rendered geometry or an equivalent stable visual signal; visibility-only assertions do not protect open-vs-closed states.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::for visual arrival requirements assert the player visible landing motion outcome not just an internal alpha or phase proxy
lessons.text: For visual-arrival requirements, assert the player-visible landing-motion outcome, not just an internal alpha or phase proxy.

lessons.key: spec_deviation::every hidden information spec deviation needs explicit tests for both the public event path and the silent ground truth fallback
lessons.text: Every hidden-information SPEC_DEVIATION needs explicit tests for both the public-event path and the silent ground-truth fallback.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::a negative assertion on a message stream needs a positive control in the same window make a live player emit the event type and assert it arrives or the absence check passes vacuously while nobody sends anything
lessons.text: A negative assertion on a message stream needs a positive control in the same window - make a live player emit the event type and assert IT arrives, or the absence check passes vacuously while nobody sends anything.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::pin state machine timing boundaries against the real transition not just the endpoints accuse one tick before and one tick after the grace ending event or a start vs completion drift survives
lessons.text: Pin state-machine timing boundaries against the real transition, not just the endpoints - accuse one tick BEFORE and one tick AFTER the grace-ending event, or a start-vs-completion drift survives.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::dwell tests assert only the 45 90 bounds pin uniformity e g min max across a sampled batch so a constant dwell mutant cannot survive
lessons.text: Dwell tests assert only the [45,90] bounds — pin uniformity (e.g. min<max across a sampled batch) so a constant-dwell mutant cannot survive.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::held arrival tests exercise only one backlog unit pin multi unit fifo release one guest per tick and queue slot x for slot 0 guests
lessons.text: Held-arrival tests exercise only one backlog unit; pin multi-unit FIFO release (one guest per tick) and queue-slot x for slot>0 guests.

lessons.key: ac_gap::edge cases room tenanted between choice and arrival and saboteur fired mid round leaves guests unchanged have no test add cheap scripted assertions or record them as structural guarantees
lessons.text: Edge cases 'room tenanted between choice and arrival' and 'saboteur fired mid-round leaves guests unchanged' have no test; add cheap scripted assertions or record them as structural guarantees.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::pin which element a fifo queue operation selects assert the specific guestid routed event not just that one was selected a wrong end selection is otherwise invisible
lessons.text: Pin WHICH element a FIFO/queue operation selects (assert the specific guestId/routed event), not just that one was selected — a wrong-end selection is otherwise invisible.

lessons.text: Never inline numeric room/floor lists in client code — derive them from shared layout constants (ROOM_INDEXES) or the §7-numeric denylist test fails the build.
